title: Eisenhower aware of foo fighters

tellings.quote: Eisenhower was aware of the Foo Fighters issue from 42 to 45.

plain: Dwight D. Eisenhower, the American general who later became president, knew about the foo fighters from 1942 to 1945. Foo fighters were the strange glowing objects that aircrews reported during the Second World War. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff says this, without naming a source, during a debate on Michels's show with a UFO skeptic, as a sign that the issue reached the very top of the military that early.
